name: James Sturman
story: James Sturman presented StoryMaps and augmented/virtual-reality approaches for river-regeneration engagement while at Aurecon in 2019. NIWA later identifies him as a Principal Technician with long experience in spatial science and GIS solution development, including climate-based geospatial products and integration of environmental and infrastructure information.
